scope: All public external source links in the Web and UI, Graphic Design, Creative Coding and Sites catalog documents. Includes 20 Creative Coding bookmarks plus one credited-original support link, quoted originals, further reading, site destinations and supporting attribution/verification links. Art & Visual Inspiration has been removed from the catalog.
keyPolicy: Retain existing non-Art stable catalog IDs, exact source URLs, source keys and saved Framer mappings. Legacy WEB-SECONDARY-01 through -04 keys map to full WEB-014 through WEB-017 entries. ART-001 through ART-006 are retired and must not be reassigned; no Art source records are retained. CC-001 through CC-020 follow the reviewed bookmark order. CC-002-02 is a credited-original support URL grouped under CC-002, not a twenty-first bookmark. GRA-READ and SITE-VERIFY remain inventory-only resources.
rightsAndAttribution: These are externally authored inspiration references, distinct from Monarchic original compositions. Posting account is not assumed to establish original artwork authorship or a reuse license. This inventory supplies no downloaded media and no invented previews.
